title: What Happens When You Tap Your Card
script: Every time Lena taps her card at the café counter, an invisible journey begins. The chip inside the card talks to the payment terminal in a secret, encrypted code. In milliseconds, her payment request leaves the café and races across the network to her bank. The bank checks three things: her balance, the amount, and where the payment comes from. Everything matches. Approved. The answer races back the same way, and a green checkmark lights up on the terminal. Lena picks up her coffee. The whole journey took just a few seconds.
